one_line: The paper develops and validates an energy end-use taxonomy, CO2 analysis, and energy performance indicators for the Swedish engineering industry (discrete manufacturing of metal products such as machined tools, automotive parts, springs, fasteners, and sheet metal), not continuous-flow production.
